megapixels._note: The only size input the served fal-ai/flux-2-max route declares (default 1, range 0.1-4). The route marks it send:false: it sets the price estimate and is not transmitted to fal. No image_size or aspect enum exists on this route.

seed._note: Unsupported: the served fal-ai/flux-2-max route takes no seed. A caller-supplied seed is not sent and the render reports a warning.

negative_prompt_policy._note: BFL official guidance: FLUX.2 has NO negative prompts. Convert to positive language. 'sharp focus throughout' NOT 'no blur'. 'empty scene' NOT 'no people'.

reference_syntax._note: The served route (fal-ai/flux-2-max, via the catalog engine model) takes prompt and megapixels only: no image_urls and no edit endpoint. Offer no references until a verified reference route is served.

official_prompt_template._note: BFL recommended structure. HEX color codes supported when keyword 'color' or 'hex' precedes the code.

validator_rules.throws: flux-2-pro: prompt is required and must be non-empty
flux-2-pro: BFL requires positive_rewrite. Found '{phrase}' at offset {offset}. Use rewrite_table or rewrite caller-side.

validator_rules._note: The served route takes no reference images, so any @imageN citation is a violation.
validator_rules.throws: flux-2-pro: @image{N} cited but the served fal-ai/flux-2-max route takes no reference images
